The Splash

Steph's jumper, in motion: one motion from the hip, gone on the way up, and he's walking away before it drops.

  1. One motion. Hip to over his head, no hitch.
  2. Gone on the way up. Out before the closeout gets there.
  3. Walking away. He turns before it drops.
